mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix removes all constraints on PermMatrix.Allowed, allowing Alloy to pick a matrix where MemberRole -> PatchTask is allowed, directly violating LeastPrivilege. The injection forces exactly that forbidden entry into the matrix.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrixViolation { MemberRole -> PatchTask in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OwnershipBasedWriteGrant decouples wrGranted from ownership and role, allowing a write request where a non-owner member is granted access. The injection forces a concrete counterexample where a MemberRole non-owner has wrGranted = BTrue.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipGrantViolation { some wr : WriteRequest | wr.wrCallerRole = MemberRole and wr.wrTask.taskOwner != wr.wrCaller and wr.wrGranted = BTrue }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_DeletedAuditExists allows a DeletedTask to exist with no CKDeleted audit entry, directly violating AuditCompleteness and FR_016_AuditSurvivesTaskDeletion. The injection forces a deleted task with no deleted audit entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DeletedAuditMissing { some t : DeletedTask | no ae : AuditEntry | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeChangeKind = CKDeleted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditTeamConsistency allows an audit entry to reference a team different from the task's team, meaning a cross-team access left a trace. The injection forces an audit entry whose aeTeam differs from its task's team.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamAuditLeak { some ae : AuditEntry, t : Team | ae.aeTeam = t and t != ae.aeTask.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CreatedAuditExists allows a task to exist without a CKCreated audit entry, violating the invariant that every task has a creation record. The injection forces a task with no CKCreated entry at all.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CreatedAuditMissing { some t : Task | no ae : AuditEntry | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeChangeKind = CKCreated }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditActorMembership allows an audit entry whose actor has no membership in the entry's team, meaning an unauthenticated or cross-team caller left a trace. The injection forces an audit entry with an actor who has no TeamMembership at all.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthoredAuditEntry { some ae : AuditEntry | no m : TeamMembership | m.mbUser = ae.aeActor and m.mbTeam = ae.aeTeam }
